Name: Night Market Expansion
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
Love the Night Market but have grown tired of the same festival year after year? Then this mod is for you!

Adds new vendors, items, animals, and more to the Night Market! To end things off, a new closing fireworks ceremony takes place after 10pm on the last day of the Night Market. (Enter beach after 10pm, can be viewed once a year)

The two extra boats have shops added to them along with six brand new boats, making eight new shops in total.

[u][b]Full List Of Changes:[/b][/u]

[u]Vendors:[/u]
Fish Shop: Sells random fish and food
Exotic ﻿Animal Shop: Sells silkworm eggs which can be placed in a coop incubator to hatch silkworms. Also sells a fox license - if you give it to Marnie she will begin to sell foxes
﻿ ﻿Note: Buying the fox license won't give you a fox, you have to buy them from Marnie after buying the license.
﻿Antique Shop: Sells various antique items such as artifacts and furniture.
﻿Mask Shop: Sells masks to celebrate the festival, including a few new hats.
﻿Food Shop: Sells random foods, including a few new recipes.
﻿Furniture Shop: Trades for new Night Market exclusive furniture.
﻿ ﻿Vases and teapot can be rotated for different patterns.
﻿Trade Shop: Has crops, trees, and materials from around the world. Trades items found around Stardew Valley for these new items.
﻿Alcohol Shop: Sells alcohol, including soju.

[u]Animals[/u]
﻿Silkworms: Coop animal that produces cocoons and silkworm eggs. Cocoons can be processed into silk - a luxury item that is loved by Emily and Sandy
﻿Fox: A pet that comes in a regular and arctic breeds. Brings you berries, fish, and drops from small animals.

[u]Hats[/u]
﻿Diving helmet, blue and red oni masks, and a moon mask - bought from the hat shop.
﻿Fur Lined Hood: Tailored using seal blubber.
﻿Fishbowl Hat: Bought from the Fish Shop.

[u]Items[/u]
﻿Nontuple shot espresso, to keep you awake during your long stay at the night market.
﻿Takoyaki: Recipe bought from food shop.
﻿Tornado Potato: Recipe bought from food shop.
﻿Lotus Root Soup: Recipe bought from trade shop.
﻿Silk: Made by putting silkworm cocoons into a loom.
﻿Seal Blubber: Can be processed into seal oil, used in a new crafting recipe, and tailored.

[u]Crops[/u]
﻿Lotus root - Grown in summer. Plant in water. (Uses Machine Terrain Framework mod - if you don't have it installed, lotus will be planted on land instead)
﻿Goji Berries - Grown in fall. Produces multiple berries each harvest. Continues to produce after first harvest.
﻿Frozen Flower - Grown in winter.
﻿Pawpaw tree - Grown in summer.


[u]Compatibility[/u]

May not work with mods that modify the Night Market
Otherwise there shouldn't be any compatibility issues, though let me know if you find any!


Hope you enjoy your improved Night Market Experience!
Feel free to comment any problems/ideas!
